o1.biggest_strength: It works the bundle economics clearly, especially the cannibalisation risk of discounting pairs customers already buy.
o1.biggest_mistake: The free-shipping recommendation leans on an assumed small ₹499-₹598 slice and does not really use the COD/RTO leak to shape the threshold or payment rules.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Add a COD/prepaid-specific shipping recommendation and verify the ₹499-₹598 order volume before recommending the ₹599 line.

o2.biggest_strength: It spots the real money leak in low-value COD orders and treats lip balm as the right cart add-on rather than a main discounted bundle.
o2.biggest_mistake: Some break-even maths is inconsistent, especially the Glow Routine break-even, which appears understated versus the stated serum-alone comparison.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Correct the bundle break-even calculations and show the working behind the threshold ranges more explicitly.

reason: I would rather use Output 2 because it is more alive to COD/RTO, the lip balm add-on, and the risk of moving the free-shipping line against the serum reorder. Output 1 has cleaner arithmetic in places, but its threshold recommendation is less grounded in the biggest leak in the data.
